## Bio

Emilie Cheng is a second-year Master's student in Epidemiology at [Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/). Her academic background began in Veterinary Medicine (DVM) at [National Taiwan University](https://www.ntu.edu.tw/english/), and she is now expanding her expertise into clinical trials, pharmacoepidemiology, and pharmacovigilance.
